summary.title: StellarPay Digital Banking Threat Model
summary.description: StellarPay Digital Banking is a secure, web-based fintech platform enabling users to create accounts, link bank cards, manage funds, and perform real-time transactions such as sending or receiving money and paying for services. The system handles highly sensitive data and integrates with external payment gateways through APIs. This threat model uses STRIDE to identify and address potential security threats prior to deployment.

threats.title: Tampering with Transaction Confirmation or Ledger After Fund Transfer
threats.description: An attacker with access to the transaction pipeline could intercept or alter the status, confirmation response, or ledger entry after a legitimate fund transfer is initiated—causing a mismatch between what the user sees and what’s actually processed.
threats.mitigation:
Digitally sign transactions and confirmations to ensure end-to-end integrity.
Implement transaction hash verification at each step.
Use immutable transaction logs (e.g., blockchain ledger or append-only databases).
Ensure role-based access control (RBAC) and audit trail for all post-transfer operations.

threats.mitigation: Make logs immutable and enable digital signing.
